title: Foreign Key Flag
statement: Implement `solve(pragma_on, bad_child)`. `pragma_on` is 1 when foreign keys were enabled. `bad_child` is 1 when the insert references a missing parent. Return `rejected` only when both are 1. Return `accepted` otherwise, including a bad child when the pragma is off.
constraints: SQLite does not enforce foreign keys until the pragma
hints: Both flags must be 1 to reject.
Do not reject a valid child.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: SQLite leaves foreign_keys off unless every connection runs the pragma.

editorial: SQLite leaves foreign_keys off unless every connection runs the pragma. A bad child insert then succeeds and the schema looks stricter than it is. Turning the pragma on makes the same insert fail. The two flags are that matrix.
